dims_mm.note: Official: 289.8 x 115 x 22.4 mm, grip area 34.8 mm. Same body for the OLED and LCD panels.

weight_g.note: 690 g with the standard modules installed. AYANEO gives one weight for both panels.

ports.note: 40 Gbps, DP 1.4; charging, data and video. 65 W PD charging with bypass.

screen.note: Two panels at the same price. Main fields describe the OLED: 1920x1080, 800 nits max, 60/90/120/144 Hz, 150% sRGB, 110% DCI-P3, HDR. LCD option: 7 in 1920x1080, 500 nits, 60/120 Hz, 7 ms, VRR, 100% sRGB, native landscape.

controls.stick_note: RGB Hall joysticks, 250 Hz report rate, on swappable Magic Modules
controls.note: Modular controller: standard module installed. Optional touchpad module (touchpad + D-pad + ABXY) and fighting module are sold separately. ABXY buttons are detachable. Dual six-axis gyroscopes. Trigger lock switches 7.5 mm linear and 3 mm micro-action modes.

cooling: Large turbo fan, triple copper heat pipes + copper sheet; up to 35 W
notes: Indiegogo early-bird price for 16GB/512GB was $699 (January 2025); retail $899. Backer shipping was planned for April 2025. release_date uses the AYANEO store listing for the 8840U model (published 2025-08-04). OLED and LCD versions share one row: same price, dimensions and stated weight.
